waypoints.name: SR-20 turnout below Le Petit Cheval (east of Washington Pass)
waypoints.note: SR-20 turnout ~2 mi east of Washington Pass; climber's trail descends to cross Early Winters Creek before ascending to the formation.
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 to the turnout below Le Petit Cheval, roughly 2 miles east of Washington Pass. Park in the turnout itself; the climbers' trail drops from its west or southwest end, so leave the car toward that end. The turnout is the trailhead — there is no side road, and the path down toward Early Winters Creek is unmarked apart from occasional cairns.

waypoints.name: Le Petit Cheval Upper Mountain
waypoints.note: 6-pitch 5.7 arete; shared topout with the other Le Petit Cheval routes.
waypoints.directions: From the west end of the turnout, follow the cairned climbers' trail steeply down into the trees, cross Early Winters Creek on logs, and climb the rocky drainage and talus toward the formation; most parties take the newer variation that bears right just before the old fixed lines. Start at the dead snags on the left before the gully and climb the arete's seven pitches, with long class 3 scrambles between them, to the top of the technical climbing.

waypoints.name: Le Petit Cheval summit
waypoints.directions: Scramble about 200 to 300 ft of class 3 along the crest, with one exposed 4th-class move near the top, to the summit.
